The bowl looks like a small cereal-type bowl, about 15 cm across at the rim. It holds white, chunky pieces that look like cubed or chopped cheese (mozzarella) or possibly potato. They are piled in the bowl, probably about 4–5 cm deep. The inner diameter is about 13 cm, so the bowl's volume is about 400 ml. If it is filled to about 70% with loosely packed chunks, that is roughly 250 ml of chunks at about 0.55 g/ml, or about 150 g.

The pieces look pale and slightly translucent, which fits cubed raw potato or mozzarella. I'll go with mozzarella-like cheese at about 280 kcal/100g.
